description: A California contractor license's record in the CSLB's public file, and every change since the directory began reading it daily: status and suspensions, workers' comp type and dates, bond amounts and dates, classes, expiry. Give a CSLB license number or a listing link. It never includes an insurer, surety or person's name, or a policy, bond or case number. Report what it says; do not judge the business. Not for decisions about a person's credit, employment, insurance or housing.
